map.对比训练与验证损失曲线，判断过拟合或欠拟合程度并给出正则化建议，适用于模型训练调: Compare the training and validation loss curves to judge the degree of overfitting or underfitting and suggest regularisation, which applies to model training tuning, early-stopping strategy design and generalisation assessment.
map.对比训练与验证损失：训练降而验证升→过拟合；两者都高→欠拟合。: Compare training and validation loss: training falls while validation rises → overfitting; both high → underfitting.
map.应尽量同分布以反映真实泛化；若验证集分布偏移，验证损失只能衡量对该子集的拟合，不: They should be as identically distributed as possible to reflect real generalisation; if the validation set distribution is shifted, the validation loss only measures the fit to that subset and does not represent online performance.
map.损失差距 = 验证损失 − 训练损失；准确率差距 = 训练准确率 − 验证准确率: Loss gap = validation loss − training loss; accuracy gap = training accuracy − validation accuracy; risk criteria: loss gap > 0.3 or accuracy gap > 10%
map.早停在验证损失连续上升前保存最优权重，是性价比最高的正则手段。: Early stopping saves the best weights before the validation loss rises consecutively, and it is the most cost-effective regularisation method.
map.训练和验证都很高怎么办？: What If Both Training and Validation Are High?
map.训练指标持续优于验证指标就是过拟合信号，差距越大越强。阈值 0.3 / 10%: Training metrics consistently better than the validation metrics is a sign of overfitting, and the larger the gap the stronger it is. The thresholds 0.3 / 10% are common rules of thumb, but the scales differ greatly across tasks, so it is more reliable to watch whether the validation loss starts rising again (which should trigger early stopping).
map.过拟合时加大 dropout、权重衰减或数据增强；欠拟合时加深加宽或减小正则。: For overfitting, increase dropout, weight decay or data augmentation; for underfitting, deepen and widen the network or reduce the regularisation strength.
map.这是欠拟合，模型容量或训练不足。可增大网络、延长训练、降低正则强度，或检查特征与: This is underfitting — the model capacity or the training is insufficient. Enlarge the network, train longer, reduce the regularisation strength, or check the quality of the features and labels.
